title: Bound on notable coordinates
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and let $T$ assign a Boolean function on the $q$-dimensional sign cube to each vertex. If $0<\varepsilon\le 1$, then at every vertex the number of coordinates whose stable influence at parameter $1-\varepsilon$ is at least $\varepsilon/2$ is at most $2/\varepsilon^2$.
